name: Scars of Fate
source:
The story takes place on the planet Aethus V, as Emperor Krux has just issued an order to arrest former Blackgate guards. But what has that to do with you?

You are just another young man who has no concerns in life, other than chasing girls and relaxing in a small town far away. However, a twisted plot lurks in the shadows that will change your life and everything else around you.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/Silent77]Patreon[/url]]
